page.overview:
Who is Alpha Prime?

Alpha Prime is one of the oldest known Matrix-bearers.

Alpha Prime did not appear in any story material, but was included in the More Than Meets The Eye guidebook's list of "Known Matrix-bearers". He was the first character in the list, and was succeeded by Guardian Prime.
